free_tier.stated: 3,000 Linux minutes a month on the free plan, with unlimited cache, every runner family and full analytics; per-second billing with a one-minute minimum beyond it. The 2 vCPU Linux x64 runner is USD 0.0040 a minute, the 2 vCPU ARM64 runner USD 0.0032, Windows USD 0.0080, macOS USD 0.0400 and an L4 GPU runner USD 0.0900.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a job is bounded by the runner size, and the page prices a 2 vCPU tier and scales linearly with size

retention.stated: not applicable: a job runs and is destroyed; the page publishes no artifact or cache retention window

egress.terms: no egress charge is published: the page says it bills per-second compute with no per-developer fee, no cache charges and no egress surprises

tooling: a one-line change to an existing GitHub Actions workflow; no agent, CLI or self-hosted runner is needed
chaining: GitHub Actions on a public repository stays free and comes first; RunnerHut buys private-repository minutes at USD 0.0040 for 2 vCPU against GitHub list price of USD 0.0060, and the 3,000 free minutes cover a small private pipeline before any card is needed

confidence_note: The free pool, the five runner rates and the billing granularity are read from the vendor own pricing page, and the no-card and drop-in claims from its homepage. Raise by running one job on the free plan and reading the minute counter and the first invoice line.
notes: A hosted GitHub Actions runner with a free pool large enough for a small private pipeline: 3,000 Linux minutes a month, no cache charge and no egress charge. The rates undercut GitHub list price on every family the page lists, and the one-minute minimum is the only rounding. The free pool is Linux only, and the runners are EU-hosted with data residency in six regions.
